description:
action="list" lists your account and strategy publications and private-link status; action="get" reads one publication using subjectKind and accountId or strategyId. Both are read-only. action="upload_image" uploads a cover image for one of your publications (a write). action="remove" unpublishes one publication by publicationId (its private link is not changed). Every action retains its original independent scopes and owner checks. Private-link secrets and broker credentials are never returned.

Set "action" to choose the operation. Only send the fields listed for that action.

## action="list": List my Marketplace publications and private grants
No other fields required.
Lists the authenticated owner's account and strategy publications, Marketplace state, explicit capabilities, and whether a private link is active. Bearer-link secrets and broker credential identifiers are never returned.

## action="get": Get my account or strategy publication
Required fields: subjectKind.
Reads one owner publication using an explicit account or strategy subject. Account sharing never implies strategy sharing; strategy sharing never exposes sibling strategies.

## action="upload_image": Upload an account or strategy Marketplace image
Required fields: publicationId, mediaType, imageBase64.
Uploads one owner publication image as bounded base64 PNG, JPG, or WebP data. The server validates and re-encodes it before private storage; remote image URLs are not accepted.

## action="remove": Remove an account or strategy from Marketplace
Required fields: publicationId.
Unpublishes exactly one owner publication. Its independent private link is not changed.

action.description: Which operation to run: "list", "get", "upload_image", "remove". See the tool description for each one.

imageBase64.description: Used with action="upload_image". Required for action="upload_image".

mediaType.description: Used with action="upload_image". Required for action="upload_image".

publicationId.description: Used with action="upload_image", action="remove". Required for action="upload_image", action="remove".

subjectKind.description: Used with action="get". Required for action="get".

name: my_marketplace_publications
title: Read, illustrate or remove my Marketplace publications
